description: IELTS listening multiple-choice questions archived after teacher confirmation.

questions.stem: How much does childcare cost for a complete afternoon session per child?
What does the manager say about food?

options.A: Children with allergies should bring their own food.
options.B: Children may bring healthy snacks with them.
options.C: Children are given a proper meal at 5 p.m.

questions.stem: What is different about arrangements in the school holidays?

options.A: Children from other schools can attend.
options.C: A greater number of children can attend.
